messages:
lina: noticed fish autocompletion shows duplicate `redwoodctl profile use` entries when i have multiple profiles that only differ by case (dev vs Dev). anyone else?
arjun: interesting. fish completions are generated from `redwoodctl completion fish` which iterates profiles and emits a `complete -c redwoodctl -f -a \"profile-name\" ...` line for each. If we emit two completions with different casing fish will still display both, but tabbing might cycle oddly.
lina: exact repro: `redwoodctl profiles` shows \"Dev\" and \"dev\" (created on mac + remote ssh) and `redwoodctl completion fish | source` gives duplicates in my menu and weird selection.
ben: fish is case-sensitive in matching but its UI dedups pretty aggressively in recent versions; maybe our completion generator uses unescaped spaces or duplicate descriptions so it collapses them visually.
arjun: can you paste `redwoodctl profiles --json`? that helps.
lina: pasted in thread: [{"name":"Dev","path":"/Users/lina/.config/redwood/profiles/Dev"},{"name":"dev","path":"/Users/lina/.config/redwood/profiles/dev"}]
ben: ok two distinct. proposal: completion generator should include the profile path as the completion description `-d` or as metadata so user can distinguish. fish supports `-d` description flag per `complete` command. That prevents accidental ambiguous selections.
arjun: also consider normalizing profile names at creation time (warn on case-insensitive collisions) or a `redwoodctl profiles rename` helper.
lina: UX note: newcomers will often paste sample profiles from docs that use `Dev` and end up with duplicates. We should surface a doctor warning `redwoodctl doctor` that lists case-collisions for profiles.
docs-bot: docs suggestion: update the quickstart to recommend lowercased profile names and show `redwoodctl profiles list` output with examples.
ben: small patch idea: change `cmd/completion/fish.go` to emit `complete -c redwoodctl -n '__fish_use_subcommand' -a \"profile use --name=Dev\" -d \"/Users/lina/.config/redwood/profiles/Dev\"` (escape appropr.). That way UI shows the path and users pick the right one.
arjun: agree. backwards-compatible and small. also add unit test asserting `-d` appears and acceptance test that completion shows description.
lina: i'll open a PR. quick fix for me: run `redwoodctl profile rename Dev dev` and the duplicates go away.
dev-bot: created issue DX-1607: "fish completion: duplicate-looking profile entries when names differ only by case; include profile path in completion description" assigned to @ben P3.
lina: thanks, i'll add a note in the PR about case-insensitive filesystems (mac) and recommend doctor warning too.
ben: cheers. :shipit:
